fix(tools): read ajv errors across both majors, cache by schema

compiler is constructed through a cast that holds for either major's
type shapes, and the schema-compile throw carries cause.

function-valued ToolDefinitionSource recompiles only when it returns a
different schema object; static tools keep their register-time
validator.

passes through toEqual and exactly once, an unregistered name throws
Unknown tool, a static schema compiles once across ten calls, a
function source validates against the schema current at each call, and
the compiled validator is reused for the same schema object. The four
previously uncited spec statements link to these tests and the spec's
status moves to Shipped; the acceptance suite keeps its assertions
while its loop provider is restructured flat and its member chains
split.

Closes re-cinq/HALEngine#37 (partially)
